summary: Be an Air Traffic Controller, direct planes to runways & avoid collisions!
description:
You are an Air Traffic Controller (ATC) or a Flight Control Manager in this simple but addictive path drawing game. While in the air traffic tower, your task is to land safely all the upcoming planes and helicopters and avoid collisions. But flying or landing planes is not the only problem! A lot of unexpected challenges and adventures are waiting for you as an ATC at your airport! Get an adrenaline rush while avoiding dangerous collisions, fly in blazing storms and tornadoes, get ready for air combat, attack enemy fighters and even shoot aliens during an alien invasion!
 
As a Flight Control Manager you have full control of the airspace, but can you actually handle the pressure and keep your airport under control? Download this great free air traffic game and find it out! 
 
GAMEPLAY 
 
✈️ Planes Control is a path drawing game with simple controls.
✈️ Draw with a finger a landing path from a plane to an airstrip where it belongs ( the colour of the plane should match the colour of the runway). This way you determine the path each plane will fly as it finds its way to land at the airport or to engage the enemy.
✈️Change direction of a plane if it’s going to crush with another aircraft or external objects. It can fly a couple of circles around the airport before landing. 
✈️Earn points to unlock new levels
 
AIRCRAFTS
 
You can navigate more than 60 different planes and helicopters including airliners, WWII fighters, jet planes, tilt rotors & zeppelins while playing this great planes game.
 
LEVELS
 
Planes Control has 13 awesome levels/ locations for mobile phones & 6 new levels for tablets. 
Your ATC tower can be almost anywhere in the world. Arizona’s desert, Australia, Pacific ocean, Taiwan and South Pole are just some of the locations. 
Each level offers different challenges and missions, starting from flying in tornadoes and storms or running out of fuel, over fighting wildfires up to air combat and alien invasions. 
Planes Control - Air Traffic Game offers a new level to play every day, so stay tuned!
